title: Banquet Event Checklist
subtitle: Capture function space, guest count, setup, and banquet timing; confirm service owner and event acceptance.
description: Banquet Event records function space, guest count, setup, banquet timing, service owner, and event acceptance. Banquet Event evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this banquet event stage-gated verification when staff must document function space and guest count. Reconcile setup, banquet timing, service owner, and event acceptance before the banquet event handoff. Use the function sheet, banquet-event order, floorplan, guaranteed count, menu schedule, audiovisual order, staffing assignment, captain report, and client signoff. Ask the assigned banquet event reviewer to confirm function space against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Banquet Event starting details
sections.guidance: Connect function space, guaranteed guest count, room setup, banquet-event order timing, meal courses, service captain, audiovisual needs, and client acceptance.

sections.title: Banquet Event checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current banquet event facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Banquet Event required checks
items: Function space is identified for this record
Guest count matches the current request or source
Setup is ready for point-of-use staff
Banquet timing limits or questions are resolved
Service owner is communicated to the responsible person
Event acceptance is confirmed at handoff
A changed banquet event fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Banquet Event failed or pending items

sections.title: Banquet Event decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold banquet event readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Banquet Event reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Banquet Event receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
